title: Feature Modules & Public APIs
objectives: Organize code by feature instead of by type
Expose an intentional public API via index.ts

examples.name: feature-layout.txt
examples.code:
src/
  features/
    checkout/
      index.ts          <- public API
      components/
      composables/
      api.ts
      store.ts
  shared/
    ui/                 <- tiny, stable
    lib/

exercise.prompt: Which imports respect the feature public API? "checkout imports from features/checkout (index)", "billing imports checkout/store.ts directly", "billing imports from features/checkout", "checkout imports shared/ui".
hints: Deep imports bypass the module contract.
shared/ is imported by everyone; features import it freely.

questions.prompt: The purpose of a feature index.ts public API is…
options: making the module surface intentional and refactor-safe
questions.explanation: A curated entry point hides internals so they can change freely.

questions.prompt: Grouping by feature beats grouping by type because…
options: changes to one feature touch one place instead of five type-folders
questions.explanation: Feature-first maximizes cohesion: a feature change is a folder change.
